statusLine.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/statusline.mjs" ] && exec node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/statusline.mjs" || { echo "[houserules] statusline.mjs missing. Run: npx houserules update" >&2; exit 1; }

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] && exec node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/hook-dispatch.mjs" || { echo "[houserules] hook-dispatch.mjs: this install's generated files are not synced yet. Run your dependency install (npm install, pnpm install, or yarn), or houserules update for a global CLI. This call is blocked until then." >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] && exec node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/hook-dispatch.mjs" || { if [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/houserules" ]; then out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/houserules" update --sync "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"); elif command -v houserules >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(houserules update --sync "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"); else echo "[houserules] hook-dispatch.mjs is not synced yet. Run your dependency install (npm install, pnpm install, or yarn) to sync this install."; fi; case "$out" in "[houserules] synced"*) echo "$out"; echo "[houserules] Restart the session so the synced skills, rules, and agents load.";; ?*) echo "$out";; esac; exit 0; }
